prompts.prompt-r1.txt: Photorealistic artistic interpretation of the Jerte Valley, Extremadura, Spain, at night. Honest moonlit treatment — no invented floodlighting. The deep valley with its terraced cherry orchards lying dark under moonlight and a starry sky, the waterfall pools of Los Pilones in the Garganta de los Infiernos gorge catching moonlight, the village of Jerte with a few warm lights below, the dark mountains of the Sierra de Béjar around. No identifiable people. Subject centred so it survives a 4:5 centre crop. No text or brand logos anywhere, no on-image text at all.
